title: Concept: Test extra declared in the distribution metadata
description: setup.cfg declares an `extras_require` entry named `test`, which leaves a dependency the reviewer cannot reason about: A name or scope that resolves outside the project's intended registry is fetched from a source nobody reviewed, so a publish there becomes an install here. This rule reads an `extras_require` entry named `test`.
applicability: Projects that resolve dependencies through setup.cfg (pypi).
risk: A name or scope that resolves outside the project's intended registry is fetched from a source nobody reviewed, so a publish there becomes an install here. This rule reads an `extras_require` entry named `test`.
